# Phase 2A - Automated Identity & Ingestion Pipeline

## Data Contracts

### Inputs
- `data/profiles/<Identity>/*.jpg` — Known identity reference images
- `data/ingest/*.jpg` — New images to process and match

### Outputs (generated by Phase 2A)
- `artifacts/profile_index.pkl` — Indexed embeddings for known identities
- `artifacts/unknown_registry.pkl` — Registry of unmatched/unknown faces
- `artifacts/ingest_log.jsonl` — Processing log for ingested images
- `artifacts/celeb_graph_phase2.gpickle` — Social graph built from Phase 2A detections

---

**Note:** Phase 1 in `../celebrity-graph` is the golden baseline and must remain untouched.
